verdict.rationale: Name.com's docs clearly document the EPP/auth-code transfer-in flow (create-transfer endpoint requiring auth code, docs-6), status tracking via the transfer.status_change webhook (docs-7) and a dedicated external-transfers-flow guide (docs-30), plus marketing pages pointing to the transfer process (docs-12, docs-24). However the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of transfer pricing/costs or what happens to remaining registration time (e.g., the standard added year) upon a successful transfer-in — the pricing docs (docs-13, docs-18) describe general TLD pricing types but not transfer-specific cost or renewal-time handling. Missing for 10: explicit transfer cost breakdown, explicit statement on remaining-time credit/extension, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the flow works as documented.
